mutations.name: ambiguous-takes-first
mutations.what: two equally good places: the first one is taken instead of refusing

patches.old: const hits = findAll(keys, needle, from, to, 2, budget);
patches.new: const hits = findAll(keys, needle, from, to, 1, budget);

mutations.name: line-numbers-ignored
mutations.what: the place the diff names does not win over another match

patches.old: if (expected !== null && expected >= from && expected <= to && findAll(keys, needle, expected, expected, 1, budget).length) return { pos: expected, fuzz: level };

mutations.name: rung-1-is-exact
mutations.what: the trailing-whitespace rung compares exactly

mutations.name: rung-3-quotes
mutations.what: curly double quotes are read as single quotes

mutations.name: ladder-stops-at-2
mutations.what: the default ladder stops before the Unicode rung

mutations.name: no-start-anchor
mutations.what: a hunk that names line 1 may move

mutations.name: no-end-anchor
mutations.what: a hunk without trailing context may match before the end

mutations.name: hunks-may-overlap
mutations.what: the next hunk is searched from the start of the file again

mutations.name: offset-not-carried
mutations.what: the offset of a hunk is not carried to the next one

mutations.name: old-no-eol-unchecked
mutations.what: the old side's missing final newline is not checked against the file

mutations.name: new-no-eol-ignored
mutations.what: the patch cannot take the final newline away

mutations.name: middle-line-no-newline
mutations.what: a line without newline that is no longer last keeps having none

mutations.name: crlf-never
mutations.what: added lines never take the CRLF of the file

mutations.name: transit-cr-kept
mutations.what: CRs added on the way are written into the file

mutations.name: bom-not-set-aside
mutations.what: the byte order mark is matched as part of the first line

mutations.name: dot-segments
mutations.what: a .. segment is allowed

mutations.name: device-names
mutations.what: a Windows device name is allowed

mutations.name: stray-lines-after-hunk
mutations.what: lines after a hunk that its header does not count are ignored

mutations.name: git-binary-patch
mutations.what: a GIT binary patch is not recognised as binary

mutations.name: delete-leaves-lines
mutations.what: a deletion that leaves lines behind is accepted

mutations.name: rename-overwrites
mutations.what: a rename onto an existing file overwrites it

mutations.name: limits-raised
mutations.what: a caller may raise a limit

mutations.name: context-free-insert-anywhere
mutations.what: a hunk without lines to match is placed by its line number alone

patches.old: else if (expected === n && n >= cursor) pos = n;
patches.new: else if (expected <= n && expected >= cursor) pos = expected;

mutations.name: first-anchor-nearest
mutations.what: the first anchor takes the nearest match instead of requiring one

mutations.name: end-of-file-marker-lost
mutations.what: the envelope end-of-file anchor is dropped

mutations.name: octal-as-decimal
mutations.what: octal escapes of quoted names are read as decimal

mutations.name: search-unbounded
mutations.what: the search cost is never counted

mutations.name: timestamp-kept
mutations.what: the timestamp after a TAB stays in the file name

mutations.name: empty-header-accepted
mutations.what: a diff --git header with nothing to change is taken as done

mutations.name: git-dir-allowed
mutations.what: a path into .git is allowed

mutations.name: utf8-length-chars
mutations.what: the size limit counts characters, not UTF-8 bytes

mutations.name: no-final-newline-marker-old
mutations.what: a no-newline marker after a - line is not recorded for the old side
